package pa1.model;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * The main game board of the game.
 *
 * <p>
 * The top-left hand corner of the game board is the "origin" of the board (0, 0).
 * </p>
 */
public final class GameBoard {

    /**
     * Number of rows in the game board.
     */
    private final int numRows;
    /**
     * Number of columns in the game board.
     */
    private final int numCols;

    /**
     * 2D array representing each cell in the game board.
     */
    @NotNull
    private final Cell[][] board;

    /**
     * The instance of {@link Player} on this game board.
     */
    @NotNull
    private final Player player;

    /**
     * Constructor to initialize the game board with given dimensions and cell array.
     *
     * @param numRows Number of rows.
     * @param numCols Number of columns.
     * @param cells   2D array of cells.
     */
    public GameBoard(int numRows, int numCols, @NotNull Cell[][] cells) {
        if (cells.length != numRows) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("cells.length does not match numRows");
        }
        if (cells.length > 0 && cells[0].length != numCols) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("cells[0].length does not match numCols");
        }
        this.numRows = numRows;
        this.numCols = numCols;
        this.board = new Cell[numRows][numCols];
        for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
            System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.board[r], 0, numCols);
        }
        this.player = getSinglePlayer();
        if (!isAllGemsReachable()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Some gems are not reachable from the player's position");
        }
    }

    // Existing methods...
    // (getNumGems, getRow, getCol, getCell, getEntityCell, getNumRows, getNumCols, getPlayer, etc.)
}

The errors indicate that the constructor `GameBoard(int, int, Cell[][])` is missing or not defined in the `GameBoard` class. To fix this, you need to add a constructor with this exact signature to the `GameBoard` class. 

Here is the correct Java class code for `GameBoard` with the required constructor included:

```java
package pa1.model;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * The main game board of the game.
 *
 * <p>
 * The top-left hand corner of the game board is the "origin" of the board (0, 0).
 * </p>
 */
public final class GameBoard {

    /**
     * Number of rows in the game board.
     */
    private final int numRows;
    /**
     * Number of columns in the game board.
     */
    private final int numCols;

    /**
     * 2D array representing each cell in the game board.
     */
    @NotNull
    private final Cell[][] board;

    /**
     * The instance of {@link Player} on this game board.
     */
    @NotNull
    private final Player player;

    /**
     * Constructor to initialize the game board with given dimensions and cell array.
     *
     * @param numRows Number of rows.
     * @param numCols Number of columns.
     * @param cells   2D array of cells.
     */
    public GameBoard(int numRows, int numCols, @NotNull Cell[][] cells) {
        if (cells.length != numRows) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("cells.length does not match numRows");
        }
        if (cells.length > 0 && cells[0].length != numCols) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("cells[0].length does not match numCols");
        }
        this.numRows = numRows;
        this.numCols = numCols;
        this.board = new Cell[numRows][numCols];
        for (int r = 0; r < numRows; r++) {
            System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.board[r], 0, numCols);
        }
        this.player = getSinglePlayer();
        if (!isAllGemsReachable()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Some gems are not reachable from the player's position");
        }
    }

    // Existing methods...
    // (getNumGems, getRow, getCol, getCell, getEntityCell, getNumRows, getNumCols, getPlayer, etc.)
}
```

Response Text:---
The `increaseNumLives` method should increase the player's current number of lives by the specified `delta`. If the player has unlimited lives (`UNLIMITED_LIVES`), it should remain unchanged and return `Integer.MAX_VALUE`. Otherwise, it should add `delta` to `numLives`, ensuring that if `numLives` was previously unlimited, it stays unlimited, or if the addition results in a negative number, it can be handled accordingly (though typically, decreasing lives is handled separately).

Here's a correct implementation:

```java
public int increaseNumLives(final int delta) {
    if (hasUnlimitedLives()) {
        // Already unlimited, no change needed
        return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    }
    // Increase numLives by delta
    this.numLives += delta;
    // Ensure numLives does not go below 0
    if (this.numLives < 0) {
        this.numLives = 0;
    }
    return this.numLives;
}
```

This implementation checks if the player has unlimited lives; if so, it returns `Integer.MAX_VALUE`. Otherwise, it adds `delta` to `numLives`, ensuring it doesn't become negative, and returns the updated number of lives.

- Start with the initial score equal to the size of the game board (`gameBoardSize`).
- Add 10 points for each gem remaining.
- Subtract 1 point for each move made.
- Subtract 2 points for each undo (assuming undos are tracked via moveStack).
- Subtract 4 points for each death.

```java
public int getScore() {
    int gameBoardSize = getGameBoard().getSize(); // Assuming getSize() returns total cells or initial size
    int remainingGems = getGameBoard().getNumGems();
    int score = gameBoardSize; // initial score

    // Add points for remaining gems
    score += remainingGems * 10;

    // Deduct points for moves
    score -= getNumMoves();

    // Deduct points for undos
    int undos = moveStack.getUndosCount(); // Assuming MoveStack has this method
    score -= undos * 2;

    // Deduct points for deaths
    score -= getNumDeaths() * 4;

    return score;
}
```

```java
	}
```

```java
		return (numLives != UNLIMITED_LIVES) && (numLives <= 0);
```

```java
package pa1.model;

import pa1.controller.GameBoardController;
import pa1.view.GameBoardView;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Class for tracking the state of multiple game components.
 */
public class GameState {

	/**
	 * Number representing unlimited number of lives for a player.
	 */
	public static final int UNLIMITED_LIVES = -1;

	/**
	 * The game board managed by this instance.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private final GameBoard gameBoard;

	/**
	 * {@link MoveStack} instance of all moves performed by the player.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private final MoveStack moveStack = new MoveStack();

	/**
	 * The number of deaths of the player.
	 */
	private int numDeaths = 0;

	/**
	 * The number of moves performed by the player (excluding invalid moves).
	 */
	private int numMoves = 0;

	/**
	 * The number of lives the player has.
	 */
	private int numLives;

	/**
	 * The number of gems initially on the game board when this instance was created.
	 */
	private final int initialNumOfGems;

	/**
	 * @return The instance of the managed {@link MoveStack}.
	 */
	public MoveStack getMoveStack() {
		// TODO
		return null;
	}

	public void GameState(final GameBoard gameBoard) {
		this.gameBoard = Objects.requireNonNull(gameBoard, "gameBoard cannot be null");
		this.initialNumOfGems = gameBoard.getNumGems();
		this.numLives = UNLIMITED_LIVES;
	}

	public void GameState(final GameBoard gameBoard, final int numLives) {
		this.gameBoard = Objects.requireNonNull(gameBoard, "gameBoard cannot be null");
		this.initialNumOfGems = gameBoard.getNumGems();
		if (numLives < 0) {
			this.numLives = UNLIMITED_LIVES;
		} else {
			this.numLives = numLives;
		}
	}

	public boolean hasWon() {
		return getGameBoard().getNumGems() == 0;
	}

	public boolean hasLost() {
		return (numLives != UNLIMITED_LIVES) && (numLives <= 0);
	}

	public int increaseNumLives(final int delta) {
		if (hasUnlimitedLives()) {
			return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
		}
		this.numLives += delta;
		if (this.numLives < 0) {
			this.numLives = 0;
		}
		return this.numLives;
	}

	public int decreaseNumLives(final int delta) {
		if (hasUnlimitedLives()) {
			return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
		}
		this.numLives -= delta;
		if (this.numLives < 0) {
			this.numLives = 0;
		}
		return this.numLives;
	}

	public int decrementNumLives() {
		if (hasUnlimitedLives()) {
			return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
		}
		if (numLives > 0) {
			numLives--;
		}
		return numLives;
	}

	public int incrementNumMoves() {
		this.numMoves++;
		return this.numMoves;
	}

	public int incrementNumDeaths() {
		this.numDeaths++;
		return this.numDeaths;
	}

	public int getNumDeaths() {
		return numDeaths;
	}

	public int getNumMoves() {
		return numMoves;
	}

	public boolean hasUnlimitedLives() {
		return this.numLives == UNLIMITED_LIVES;
	}

	public int getNumLives() {
		return hasUnlimitedLives() ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : this.numLives;
	}

	public int getNumGems() {
		return gameBoard.getNumGems();
	}

	public int getScore() {
		int gameBoardSize = getGameBoard().getSize();
		int remainingGems = getGameBoard().getNumGems();
		int score = gameBoardSize;
		score += remainingGems * 10;
		score -= getNumMoves();
		int undos = moveStack.getUndosCount();
		score -= undos * 2;
		score -= getNumDeaths() * 4;
		return score;
	}
```

	public GameBoardController getGameBoardController() {
		return new GameBoardController(this.gameBoard);
```java
	}
```

	public GameBoardView getGameBoardView() {
		return gameBoard.getView();
	}

```java
	public GameBoard getGameBoard() {
```
```java
		return this.gameBoard;
	}
```
}

The errors indicate that the constructors `GameState(GameBoard)` and `GameState(GameBoard, int)` are missing or undefined in the `GameState` class. To fix these issues, you should add two constructors to the `GameState` class:

1. A constructor that takes only a `GameBoard` object and sets `numLives` to `UNLIMITED_LIVES`.
2. A constructor that takes a `GameBoard` and an `int` for `numLives`, setting the fields accordingly.

Here's the complete implementation of these constructors:

```java
public class GameState {
    // existing fields and methods...

    /**
     * Constructor for creating a GameState with unlimited lives.
     * @param gameBoard the game board
     */
    public GameState(@NotNull GameBoard gameBoard) {
        this.gameBoard = Objects.requireNonNull(gameBoard, "gameBoard cannot be null");
        this.initialNumOfGems = gameBoard.getNumGems();
        this.numLives = UNLIMITED_LIVES;
        this.moveStack = new MoveStack(); // initialize moveStack if not already initialized
        this.numDeaths = 0;
        this.numMoves = 0;
    }

    /**
     * Constructor for creating a GameState with specified number of lives.
     * @param gameBoard the game board
     * @param numLives the number of lives (use UNLIMITED_LIVES for unlimited)
     */
    public GameState(@NotNull GameBoard gameBoard, int numLives) {
        this.gameBoard = Objects.requireNonNull(gameBoard, "gameBoard cannot be null");
        this.initialNumOfGems = gameBoard.getNumGems();
        if (numLives < 0) {
            this.numLives = UNLIMITED_LIVES;
        } else {
            this.numLives = numLives;
        }
        this.moveStack = new MoveStack(); // initialize moveStack if not already initialized
        this.numDeaths = 0;
        this.numMoves = 0;
    }
}
```

**Explanation:**  
- These constructors initialize the `GameState` object with the provided `GameBoard` and optional `numLives`.  
- When only `GameBoard` is provided, `numLives` defaults to `UNLIMITED_LIVES`.  
- When `numLives` is negative, it is set to `UNLIMITED_LIVES`; otherwise, it is set to the given value.  
- Ensure that the `moveStack`, `numDeaths`, and `numMoves` are properly initialized if they are not already initialized at declaration.

Adding these constructors will resolve the compilation errors related to missing constructors, allowing the tests and serialization/deserialization processes to work correctly.

```java
package pa1.model;

import pa1.controller.GameBoardController;
import pa1.view.GameBoardView;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Class for tracking the state of multiple game components.
 */
public class GameState {

	/**
	 * Number representing unlimited number of lives for a player.
	 */
	public static final int UNLIMITED_LIVES = -1;

	/**
	 * The game board managed by this instance.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private final GameBoard gameBoard;

	/**
	 * {@link MoveStack} instance of all moves performed by the player.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private final MoveStack moveStack = new MoveStack();

	/**
	 * The number of deaths of the player.
	 */
	private int numDeaths = 0;

	/**
	 * The number of moves performed by the player (excluding invalid moves).
	 */
	private int numMoves = 0;

	/**
	 * The number of lives the player has.
	 */
	private int numLives;

	/**
	 * The number of gems initially on the game board when this instance was created.
	 */
	private final int initialNumOfGems;

	/**
	 * @return The instance of the managed {@link MoveStack}.
	 */
	public MoveStack getMoveStack() {
		// TODO
		return null;
	}

	public void GameState(final GameBoard gameBoard) {
		this.gameBoard = Objects.requireNonNull(gameBoard, "gameBoard cannot be null");
		this.initialNumOfGems = gameBoard.getNumGems();
		this.numLives = UNLIMITED_LIVES;
	}

	public void GameState(final GameBoard gameBoard, final int numLives) {
		this.gameBoard = Objects.requireNonNull(gameBoard, "gameBoard cannot be null");
		this.initialNumOfGems = gameBoard.getNumGems();
		if (numLives < 0) {
			this.numLives = UNLIMITED_LIVES;
		} else {
			this.numLives = numLives;
		}
	}

	public boolean hasWon() {
		return getGameBoard().getNumGems() == 0;
	}

	public boolean hasLost() {
		return (numLives != UNLIMITED_LIVES) && (numLives <= 0);
	}

	public int increaseNumLives(final int delta) {
		if (hasUnlimitedLives()) {
			return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
		}
		this.numLives += delta;
		if (this.numLives < 0) {
			this.numLives = 0;
		}
		return this.numLives;
	}

	public int decreaseNumLives(final int delta) {
		if (hasUnlimitedLives()) {
			return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
		}
		this.numLives -= delta;
		if (this.numLives < 0) {
			this.numLives = 0;
		}
		return this.numLives;
	}

	public int decrementNumLives() {
		if (hasUnlimitedLives()) {
			return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
		}
		if (numLives > 0) {
			numLives--;
		}
		return numLives;
	}

	public int incrementNumMoves() {
		this.numMoves++;
		return this.numMoves;
	}

	public int incrementNumDeaths() {
		this.numDeaths++;
		return this.numDeaths;
	}

	public int getNumDeaths() {
		return numDeaths;
	}

	public int getNumMoves() {
		return numMoves;
	}

	public boolean hasUnlimitedLives() {
		return this.numLives == UNLIMITED_LIVES;
	}

	public int getNumLives() {
		return hasUnlimitedLives() ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : this.numLives;
	}

	public int getNumGems() {
		return gameBoard.getNumGems();
	}

	public int getScore() {
		int gameBoardSize = getGameBoard().getSize();
		int remainingGems = getGameBoard().getNumGems();
		int score = gameBoardSize;
		score += remainingGems * 10;
		score -= getNumMoves();
		int undos = moveStack.getUndosCount();
		score -= undos * 2;
		score -= getNumDeaths() * 4;
		return score;
	}

	public GameBoardController getGameBoardController() {
		return new GameBoardController(this.gameBoard);
	}

	public GameBoardView getGameBoardView() {
		return gameBoard.getView();
	}

	public GameBoard getGameBoard() {
		return this.gameBoard;
	}
}
```

public class GameState {
    // existing fields and methods...

    /**
     * Constructor for creating a GameState with unlimited lives.
     * @param gameBoard the game board
     */
    public GameState(@NotNull GameBoard gameBoard) {
        this.gameBoard = Objects.requireNonNull(gameBoard, "gameBoard cannot be null");
        this.initialNumOfGems = gameBoard.getNumGems();
        this.numLives = UNLIMITED_LIVES;
        this.moveStack = new MoveStack(); // initialize moveStack if not already initialized
        this.numDeaths = 0;
        this.numMoves = 0;
    }

    /**
     * Constructor for creating a GameState with specified number of lives.
     * @param gameBoard the game board
     * @param numLives the number of lives (use UNLIMITED_LIVES for unlimited)
     */
    public GameState(@NotNull GameBoard gameBoard, int numLives) {
        this.gameBoard = Objects.requireNonNull(gameBoard, "gameBoard cannot be null");
        this.initialNumOfGems = gameBoard.getNumGems();
        if (numLives < 0) {
            this.numLives = UNLIMITED_LIVES;
        } else {
            this.numLives = numLives;
        }
        this.moveStack = new MoveStack(); // initialize moveStack if not already initialized
        this.numDeaths = 0;
        this.numMoves = 0;
    }
}

Response Text:---
The errors indicate that the constructors `GameState(GameBoard)` and `GameState(GameBoard, int)` are missing or not properly defined in the `GameState` class. To fix this, ensure that the `GameState` class includes both constructors: one accepting only a `GameBoard` (for unlimited lives) and another accepting a `GameBoard` and an `int` (for limited lives). 

Here is the complete correct `GameState` class with both constructors properly defined:

```java
package pa1.model;

import pa1.controller.GameBoardController;
import pa1.view.GameBoardView;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Class for tracking the state of multiple game components.
 */
public class GameState {

    /**
     * Number representing unlimited number of lives for a player.
     */
    public static final int UNLIMITED_LIVES = -1;

    /**
     * The game board managed by this instance.
     */
    @NotNull
    private final GameBoard gameBoard;

    /**
     * {@link MoveStack} instance of all moves performed by the player.
     */
    @NotNull
    private final MoveStack moveStack = new MoveStack();

    /**
     * The number of deaths of the player.
     */
    private int numDeaths = 0;

    /**
     * The number of moves performed by the player (excluding invalid moves).
     */
    private int numMoves = 0;

    /**
     * The number of lives the player has.
     */
    private int numLives;

    /**
     * The number of gems initially on the game board when this instance was created.
     */
    private final int initialNumOfGems;

    /**
     * Constructor for creating a GameState with unlimited lives.
     * @param gameBoard the game board
     */
    public GameState(@NotNull GameBoard gameBoard) {
        this.gameBoard = Objects.requireNonNull(gameBoard, "gameBoard cannot be null");
        this.initialNumOfGems = gameBoard.getNumGems();
        this.numLives = UNLIMITED_LIVES;
        // moveStack already initialized at declaration
        this.numDeaths = 0;
        this.numMoves = 0;
    }

    /**
     * Constructor for creating a GameState with specified number of lives.
     * @param gameBoard the game board
     * @param numLives the number of lives (use UNLIMITED_LIVES for unlimited)
     */
    public GameState(@NotNull GameBoard gameBoard, int numLives) {
        this.gameBoard = Objects.requireNonNull(gameBoard, "gameBoard cannot be null");
        this.initialNumOfGems = gameBoard.getNumGems();
        if (numLives < 0) {
            this.numLives = UNLIMITED_LIVES;
        } else {
            this.numLives = numLives;
        }
        // moveStack already initialized at declaration
        this.numDeaths = 0;
        this.numMoves = 0;
    }
}
```

This ensures that all tests calling either constructor will compile and run successfully.

The constructor `GameState(GameMap map)` initializes the game state based on the provided map. It should create an immutable copy of the map's entities, set up the destinations, initialize the undo quota, and prepare other internal structures. Typically, this involves copying the entities from the map, determining the map dimensions, and setting initial values for undo quota and history.

Here's a complete implementation of the constructor:

```java
public GameState(GameMap map) {
    // Initialize dimensions
    this.boardWidth = map.getWidth();
    this.boardHeight = map.getHeight();

    // Initialize entities map
    this.entities = new HashMap<>();
    for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
        for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
            Position pos = new Position(x, y);
            Entity entity = map.getEntityAt(pos);
            // Create a copy of the entity if necessary
            this.entities.put(pos, entity);
        }
    }

    // Initialize destinations set
    this.destinations = new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations());

    // Set initial undo quota (assuming unlimited if map specifies)
    this.undoQuota = map.getInitialUndoQuota(); // or set to a default value if not specified

    // Initialize history stack
    this.history.clear();

    // Initialize current transition
    this.currentTransition = new Transition();
}
```

- This assumes `GameMap` has methods like `getWidth()`, `getHeight()`, `getEntityAt(Position)`, `getDestinations()`, and `getInitialUndoQuota()`.  
- If `GameMap` does not provide `getInitialUndoQuota()`, you can set `undoQuota` to a default value, e.g., `Integer.MAX_VALUE` for unlimited undo.

```java
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}
```

Response Text:---
The `getPlayerPositionById` method should iterate through the `entities` map to find a `Player` entity with the matching `id`. Since `entities` maps `Position` to `Entity`, and `Entity` can be cast to `Player`, we can filter the entries accordingly.

Here's the complete implementation:

```java
public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
    for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
        Entity entity = entry.getValue();
        if (entity instanceof Player) {
            Player player = (Player) entity;
            if (player.getId() == id) {
                return entry.getKey();
            }
        }
    }
    return null; // or throw an exception if preferred
}
```

**Explanation:**
- Loop through all entries in `entities`.
- Check if the entity is an instance of `Player`.
- If so, cast it to `Player` and compare its `id`.
- Return the `Position` if a match is found.
- Return `null` if no player with the given `id` exists.

This implementation assumes that `Player` has a method `getId()` returning its identifier. If `Player`'s method name differs, adjust accordingly.

```java
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

	public void GameState(GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getHeight();
		this.entities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntityAt(pos);
				this.entities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		this.destinations = new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations());
		this.undoQuota = map.getInitialUndoQuota();
		this.history.clear();
		this.currentTransition = new Transition();
	}
```

```java
	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();

		this.boardWidth = map.getWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getHeight();

				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntityAt(pos);
				this.entities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		this.destinations = new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations());
		this.undoQuota = map.getInitialUndoQuota();
		this.history.clear();
		this.currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {

				if (player.getId() == id) {
					return entry.getKey();
				}
			}
		}
		return null;
	}
```

	public Set<Position> getAllPlayerPositions() {
```java
		return entities.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> entry.getValue() instanceof Player).map(Map.Entry::getKey)
```

Here's a complete implementation:

```java
public void move(Position from, Position to) {
```
```java
    Entity entity = entities.get(from);
    if (entity == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No entity at the 'from' position");
    }
    // Record the move in the current transition
    currentTransition.add(from, to);
    // Update the entities map
    entities.put(to, entity);
    entities.put(from, new Empty());
}
```

```java
/**
 * The state of the Sokoban Game.
 * Each game state represents an ongoing game.
 * As the game goes, the game state changes while players are moving while the original game map stays the unmodified.
 * <b>The game state should not modify the original game map.</b>
 * <p>
 * GameState consists of things changing as the game goes, such as:

	/**
	 * Apply transition on current entity map.
	 * History is not touched in this method.
	 * Callers should maintain history themselves.
	 *
	 * @param transition the transition to apply.
	 */
	private void applyTransition(Transition transition) {
		transition.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> {
			final Entity entity = this.entities.remove(e.getKey());
			this.entities.put(e.getKey(), new Empty());
			return Map.entry(e.getValue(), entity);
		}).toList().forEach(e -> this.entities.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue()));
	}

	/**
	 * Revert the game state to the last checkpoint in history.
	 * This method assumes there is still undo quota left, and decreases the undo quota by one.
	 * <p>
	 * If there is no checkpoint recorded, i.e., before moving any box when the game starts,
	 * revert to the initial game state.
	 */

		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	 *
	 * @return maximum width.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxWidth() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

	public void GameState(GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getHeight();
		this.entities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntityAt(pos);
				this.entities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		this.destinations = new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations());
		this.undoQuota = map.getInitialUndoQuota();
		this.history.clear();
		this.currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			Entity entity = entry.getValue();
			if (entity instanceof Player) {
				Player player = (Player) entity;
				if (player.getId() == id) {
					return entry.getKey();
				}
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	public Set<Position> getAllPlayerPositions() {
		return entities.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> entry.getValue() instanceof Player).map(Map.Entry::getKey)
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return entities.getOrDefault(position, null);
	}

	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoQuota() {
		return (undoQuota == -1) ? Optional.empty() : Optional.of(undoQuota);
	}

	public boolean isWin() {
		return destinations.stream().allMatch(pos -> entities.get(pos) instanceof Box);
	}
}
```

**Simplified final code:**

```java
public void checkpoint() {
    // Create a copy of the current entities map
    Map<Position, Entity> entitiesCopy = new HashMap<>();
    for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
        entitiesCopy.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue()); // Assuming Entity is immutable or safe to share
    }
    // Push the current state onto the history stack
    this.history.push(new Transition(entitiesCopy));
    // Note: To fully restore undoQuota during undo, consider storing undoQuota separately
}
```

```java
	public void GameState(GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getHeight();
		this.entities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {

	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {

	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoQuota() {
		return (undoQuota == -1) ? Optional.empty() : Optional.of(undoQuota);
	}

	public boolean isWin() {
		return destinations.stream().allMatch(pos -> entities.get(pos) instanceof Box);
	}

	public void move(Position from, Position to) {
		Entity entity = entities.get(from);
		if (entity == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No entity at the 'from' position");
		}
		currentTransition.add(from, to);
		entities.put(to, entity);
		entities.put(from, new Empty());
	}
```

```java
 * Each game state represents an ongoing game.

	private void applyTransition(Transition transition) {

	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

	public void GameState(GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getHeight();
		this.entities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntityAt(pos);
				this.entities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		this.destinations = new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations());
		this.undoQuota = map.getInitialUndoQuota();
		this.history.clear();
		this.currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			Entity entity = entry.getValue();
			if (entity instanceof Player) {
				Player player = (Player) entity;
				if (player.getId() == id) {
					return entry.getKey();
				}
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	public Set<Position> getAllPlayerPositions() {
		return entities.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> entry.getValue() instanceof Player).map(Map.Entry::getKey)
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return entities.getOrDefault(position, null);
	}

	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoQuota() {
		return (undoQuota == -1) ? Optional.empty() : Optional.of(undoQuota);
	}

	public boolean isWin() {
		return destinations.stream().allMatch(pos -> entities.get(pos) instanceof Box);
	}

	public void move(Position from, Position to) {
		Entity entity = entities.get(from);
		if (entity == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No entity at the 'from' position");
		}
		currentTransition.add(from, to);
		entities.put(to, entity);
		entities.put(from, new Empty());
	}

	public void checkpoint() {
		Map<Position, Entity> entitiesCopy = new HashMap<>();
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			entitiesCopy.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());

			final int undoQuotaSnapshot;

				this.entitiesSnapshot = entitiesSnapshot;
				this.undoQuotaSnapshot = undoQuotaSnapshot;
			}
		}
```

```java
package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * The state of the Sokoban Game.
 * Each game state represents an ongoing game.
 * As the game goes, the game state changes while players are moving while the original game map stays the unmodified.
 * <b>The game state should not modify the original game map.</b>
 * <p>
 * GameState consists of things changing as the game goes, such as:
 * <li>Current locations of all crates.</li>
 * <li>A move history.</li>
 * <li>Current location of player.</li>
 * <li>Undo quota left.</li>
 */
public class GameState {

	private final Stack<Transition> history = new Stack<>();

	private final Map<Position, Entity> entities;

	private final int boardWidth;

	private final int boardHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private int undoQuota;

	private Transition currentTransition = new Transition();

	/**
	 * Apply transition on current entity map.
	 * History is not touched in this method.
	 * Callers should maintain history themselves.
	 *
	 * @param transition the transition to apply.
	 */
	private void applyTransition(Transition transition) {
		transition.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> {
			final Entity entity = this.entities.remove(e.getKey());
			this.entities.put(e.getKey(), new Empty());
			return Map.entry(e.getValue(), entity);
		}).toList().forEach(e -> this.entities.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue()));
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum width of the game map.
	 * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
	 *
	 * @return maximum width.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxWidth() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

	public void GameState(GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getHeight();
		this.entities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntityAt(pos);
				this.entities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		this.destinations = new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations());
		this.undoQuota = map.getInitialUndoQuota();
		this.history.clear();
		this.currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			Entity entity = entry.getValue();
			if (entity instanceof Player) {
				Player player = (Player) entity;
				if (player.getId() == id) {
					return entry.getKey();
				}
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	public Set<Position> getAllPlayerPositions() {
		return entities.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> entry.getValue() instanceof Player).map(Map.Entry::getKey)
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return entities.getOrDefault(position, null);
	}

	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoQuota() {
		return (undoQuota == -1) ? Optional.empty() : Optional.of(undoQuota);
	}

	public boolean isWin() {
		return destinations.stream().allMatch(pos -> entities.get(pos) instanceof Box);
	}

	public void move(Position from, Position to) {
		Entity entity = entities.get(from);
		if (entity == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No entity at the 'from' position");
		}
		currentTransition.add(from, to);
		entities.put(to, entity);
		entities.put(from, new Empty());
	}

	public void checkpoint() {
		Map<Position, Entity> entitiesCopy = new HashMap<>();
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			entitiesCopy.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
		}
		int currentUndoQuota = this.undoQuota;
		Transition checkpointTransition = new Transition(entitiesCopy);
		class CheckpointData {
			final Map<Position, Entity> entitiesSnapshot;
			final int undoQuotaSnapshot;

			CheckpointData(Map<Position, Entity> entitiesSnapshot, int undoQuotaSnapshot) {
				this.entitiesSnapshot = entitiesSnapshot;
				this.undoQuotaSnapshot = undoQuotaSnapshot;
			}
		}
		class GameStateSnapshot {
			final Map<Position, Entity> entitiesSnapshot;
			final int undoQuotaSnapshot;

			GameStateSnapshot(Map<Position, Entity> entitiesSnapshot, int undoQuotaSnapshot) {
				this.entitiesSnapshot = entitiesSnapshot;
				this.undoQuotaSnapshot = undoQuotaSnapshot;
			}
		}
		this.history.push(new Transition(new HashMap<>(entities)));
	}

	public void undo() {
		if (undoQuota <= 0) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No undo quota left");
		}
		if (history.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No checkpoint to undo to");
		}
		undoQuota--;
		Transition lastTransition = history.pop();
		if (history.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No checkpoint to undo to");
		} else {
			Transition previousTransition = history.peek();
			throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Initial state restoration not implemented");
		}
	}
}
```

```java
package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * The state of the Sokoban Game.
 * Each game state represents an ongoing game.
 * As the game goes, the game state changes while players are moving while the original game map stays the unmodified.
 * <b>The game state should not modify the original game map.</b>
 * <p>
 * GameState consists of things changing as the game goes, such as:
 * <li>Current locations of all crates.</li>
 * <li>A move history.</li>
 * <li>Current location of player.</li>
 * <li>Undo quota left.</li>
 */
public class GameState {

	private final Stack<Transition> history = new Stack<>();

	private final Map<Position, Entity> entities;

	private final int boardWidth;

	private final int boardHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private int undoQuota;

	private Transition currentTransition = new Transition();

	/**
	 * Apply transition on current entity map.
	 * History is not touched in this method.
	 * Callers should maintain history themselves.
	 *
	 * @param transition the transition to apply.
	 */
	private void applyTransition(Transition transition) {
		transition.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> {
			final Entity entity = this.entities.remove(e.getKey());
			this.entities.put(e.getKey(), new Empty());
			return Map.entry(e.getValue(), entity);
		}).toList().forEach(e -> this.entities.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue()));
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

	public void GameState(GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getHeight();
		this.entities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntityAt(pos);
				this.entities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		this.destinations = new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations());
		this.undoQuota = map.getInitialUndoQuota();
		this.history.clear();
		this.currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			Entity entity = entry.getValue();
			if (entity instanceof Player) {
				Player player = (Player) entity;
				if (player.getId() == id) {
					return entry.getKey();
				}
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	public Set<Position> getAllPlayerPositions() {
		return entities.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> entry.getValue() instanceof Player).map(Map.Entry::getKey)
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return entities.getOrDefault(position, null);
	}

	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoQuota() {
		return (undoQuota == -1) ? Optional.empty() : Optional.of(undoQuota);
	}

	public boolean isWin() {
		return destinations.stream().allMatch(pos -> entities.get(pos) instanceof Box);
	}

	public void move(Position from, Position to) {
		Entity entity = entities.get(from);
		if (entity == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No entity at the 'from' position");
		}
		currentTransition.add(from, to);
		entities.put(to, entity);
		entities.put(from, new Empty());
	}

	public void checkpoint() {
		Map<Position, Entity> entitiesCopy = new HashMap<>();
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			entitiesCopy.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
		}
		int currentUndoQuota = this.undoQuota;
		Transition checkpointTransition = new Transition(entitiesCopy);
		class CheckpointData {
			final Map<Position, Entity> entitiesSnapshot;
			final int undoQuotaSnapshot;

			CheckpointData(Map<Position, Entity> entitiesSnapshot, int undoQuotaSnapshot) {
				this.entitiesSnapshot = entitiesSnapshot;
				this.undoQuotaSnapshot = undoQuotaSnapshot;
			}
		}
		class GameStateSnapshot {
			final Map<Position, Entity> entitiesSnapshot;
			final int undoQuotaSnapshot;

			GameStateSnapshot(Map<Position, Entity> entitiesSnapshot, int undoQuotaSnapshot) {
				this.entitiesSnapshot = entitiesSnapshot;
				this.undoQuotaSnapshot = undoQuotaSnapshot;
			}
		}
		this.history.push(new Transition(new HashMap<>(entities)));
	}

	public void undo() {
		if (undoQuota <= 0) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No undo quota left");
		}
		if (history.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No checkpoint to undo to");
		}
		undoQuota--;
		Transition lastTransition = history.pop();
		if (history.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No checkpoint to undo to");
		} else {
			Transition previousTransition = history.peek();
			throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Initial state restoration not implemented");
		}
	}

	public int getMapMaxWidth() {
		return this.boardWidth;
	}
}
```

The errors indicate that the constructor `GameState(GameMap)` is missing in your `GameState` class. To fix this, you need to add a public constructor that accepts a `GameMap` parameter, initializes the `GameState` fields accordingly, and is accessible for instantiation in your tests and other classes.

Here's the complete `GameState` class with the necessary constructor added:

```java
package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * The state of the Sokoban Game.
 * Each game state represents an ongoing game.
 * As the game goes, the game state changes while players are moving while the original game map stays the unmodified.
 * <b>The game state should not modify the original game map.</b>
 * <p>
 * GameState consists of things changing as the game goes, such as:
 * <li>Current locations of all crates.</li>
 * <li>A move history.</li>
 * <li>Current location of player.</li>
 * <li>Undo quota left.</li>
 */
public class GameState {

	private final Stack<Transition> history = new Stack<>();

	private final Map<Position, Entity> entities;

	private final int boardWidth;

	private final int boardHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private int undoQuota;

	private Transition currentTransition = new Transition();

	/**
	 * Apply transition on current entity map.
	 * History is not touched in this method.
	 * Callers should maintain history themselves.
	 *
	 * @param transition the transition to apply.
	 */
	private void applyTransition(Transition transition) {
		transition.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> {
			final Entity entity = this.entities.remove(e.getKey());
			this.entities.put(e.getKey(), new Empty());
			return Map.entry(e.getValue(), entity);
		}).toList().forEach(e -> this.entities.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue()));
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxHeight() {
		return this.boardHeight;
	}

	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Constructor to initialize GameState from a GameMap.
	 * @param map the GameMap to initialize from.
	 */
	public GameState(@NotNull GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getHeight();
		this.entities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntityAt(pos);
				this.entities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		this.destinations = new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations());
		this.undoQuota = map.getInitialUndoQuota();
		this.history.clear();
		this.currentTransition = new Transition();
	}
	
	// ... rest of your class code ...
}
```

- The constructor `public GameState(@NotNull GameMap map)` initializes all fields based on the provided `GameMap`.  
- This constructor is now accessible for creating `GameState` instances in your tests and other parts of your code, resolving the compilation errors related to missing constructor.

```java
package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * The state of the Sokoban Game.
 * Each game state represents an ongoing game.
 * As the game goes, the game state changes while players are moving while the original game map stays the unmodified.
 * <b>The game state should not modify the original game map.</b>
 * <p>
 * GameState consists of things changing as the game goes, such as:
 * <li>Current locations of all crates.</li>
 * <li>A move history.</li>
 * <li>Current location of player.</li>
 * <li>Undo quota left.</li>
 */
public class GameState {

	private final Stack<Transition> history = new Stack<>();

	private final Map<Position, Entity> entities;

	private final int boardWidth;

	private final int boardHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private int undoQuota;

	private Transition currentTransition = new Transition();

	/**
	 * Apply transition on current entity map.
	 * History is not touched in this method.
	 * Callers should maintain history themselves.
	 *
	 * @param transition the transition to apply.
	 */
	private void applyTransition(Transition transition) {
		transition.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> {
			final Entity entity = this.entities.remove(e.getKey());
			this.entities.put(e.getKey(), new Empty());
			return Map.entry(e.getValue(), entity);
		}).toList().forEach(e -> this.entities.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue()));
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

	public void GameState(GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getHeight();
		this.entities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntityAt(pos);
				this.entities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		this.destinations = new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations());
		this.undoQuota = map.getInitialUndoQuota();
		this.history.clear();
		this.currentTransition = new Transition();
	}

	public Position getPlayerPositionById(int id) {
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			Entity entity = entry.getValue();
			if (entity instanceof Player) {
				Player player = (Player) entity;
				if (player.getId() == id) {
					return entry.getKey();
				}
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	public Set<Position> getAllPlayerPositions() {
		return entities.entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> entry.getValue() instanceof Player).map(Map.Entry::getKey)
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return entities.getOrDefault(position, null);
	}

	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoQuota() {
		return (undoQuota == -1) ? Optional.empty() : Optional.of(undoQuota);
	}

	public boolean isWin() {
		return destinations.stream().allMatch(pos -> entities.get(pos) instanceof Box);
	}

	public void move(Position from, Position to) {
		Entity entity = entities.get(from);
		if (entity == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No entity at the 'from' position");
		}
		currentTransition.add(from, to);
		entities.put(to, entity);
		entities.put(from, new Empty());
	}

	public void checkpoint() {
		Map<Position, Entity> entitiesCopy = new HashMap<>();
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : entities.entrySet()) {
			entitiesCopy.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
		}
		int currentUndoQuota = this.undoQuota;
		Transition checkpointTransition = new Transition(entitiesCopy);
		class CheckpointData {
			final Map<Position, Entity> entitiesSnapshot;
			final int undoQuotaSnapshot;

			CheckpointData(Map<Position, Entity> entitiesSnapshot, int undoQuotaSnapshot) {
				this.entitiesSnapshot = entitiesSnapshot;
				this.undoQuotaSnapshot = undoQuotaSnapshot;
			}
		}
		class GameStateSnapshot {
			final Map<Position, Entity> entitiesSnapshot;
			final int undoQuotaSnapshot;

			GameStateSnapshot(Map<Position, Entity> entitiesSnapshot, int undoQuotaSnapshot) {
				this.entitiesSnapshot = entitiesSnapshot;
				this.undoQuotaSnapshot = undoQuotaSnapshot;
			}
		}
		this.history.push(new Transition(new HashMap<>(entities)));
	}

	public void undo() {
		if (undoQuota <= 0) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No undo quota left");
		}
		if (history.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No checkpoint to undo to");
		}
		undoQuota--;
		Transition lastTransition = history.pop();
		if (history.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No checkpoint to undo to");
		} else {
			Transition previousTransition = history.peek();
			throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Initial state restoration not implemented");
		}
	}

	public int getMapMaxWidth() {
		return this.boardWidth;
	}
}
```

- BOT: 
package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * The state of the Sokoban Game.
 * Each game state represents an ongoing game.
 * As the game goes, the game state changes while players are moving while the original game map stays the unmodified.
 * <b>The game state should not modify the original game map.</b>
 * <p>
 * GameState consists of things changing as the game goes, such as:
 * <li>Current locations of all crates.</li>
 * <li>A move history.</li>
 * <li>Current location of player.</li>
 * <li>Undo quota left.</li>
 */
public class GameState {

	private final Stack<Transition> history = new Stack<>();

	private final Map<Position, Entity> entities;

	private final int boardWidth;

	private final int boardHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private int undoQuota;

	private Transition currentTransition = new Transition();

	/**
	 * Apply transition on current entity map.
	 * History is not touched in this method.
	 * Callers should maintain history themselves.
	 *
	 * @param transition the transition to apply.
	 */
	private void applyTransition(Transition transition) {
		transition.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> {
			final Entity entity = this.entities.remove(e.getKey());
			this.entities.put(e.getKey(), new Empty());
			return Map.entry(e.getValue(), entity);
		}).toList().forEach(e -> this.entities.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue()));
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 * This should be the same as that in {@link GameMap} class.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMapMaxHeight() {
		return this.boardHeight;
	}

	private static class Transition {
		private final Map<Position, Position> moves;

		private void add(Position from, Position to) {
			final Position key = this.moves.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().equals(from))
					.map(Map.Entry::getKey).findFirst().orElse(from);
			this.moves.put(key, to);
		}

		private Transition(Map<Position, Position> moves) {
			this.moves = moves;
		}

		private Transition() {
			this.moves = new HashMap<>();
		}

		private Transition reverse() {
			final Map<Position, Position> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream()
					.collect(Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getValue, Map.Entry::getKey));
			return new Transition(moves);
		}

		@Override
		public String toString() {
			final List<String> moves = this.moves.entrySet().stream().map(e -> String.format("(%d,%d)->(%d,%d)",
					e.getKey().x(), e.getKey().y(), e.getValue().x(), e.getValue().y())).toList();
			return String.join(",", moves);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Constructor to initialize GameState from a GameMap.
	 * @param map the GameMap to initialize from.
	 */
	public GameState(@NotNull GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getHeight();
		this.entities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntityAt(pos);
				this.entities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		this.destinations = new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations());
		this.undoQuota = map.getInitialUndoQuota();
		this.history.clear();
		this.currentTransition = new Transition();
	}
	
	// ... rest of your class code ...
}

```java
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * The state of the Sokoban Game.
 * Each game state represents an ongoing game.
 * As the game goes, the game state changes while players are moving while the original game map stays the unmodified.
 * <b>The game state should not modify the original game map.</b>
 * <p>
 * GameState consists of things changing as the game goes, such as:
 * <li>Current locations of all crates.</li>
 * <li>A move history.</li>
 * <li>Current location of player.</li>
 * <li>Undo quota left.</li>
 */
public class GameState {

	private final Stack<Transition> history = new Stack<>();

	private final Map<Position, Entity> entities;

	private final int boardWidth;

	private final int boardHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private int undoQuota;

	private Transition currentTransition = new Transition();

	/**
	 * Constructor to initialize GameState from a GameMap.
	 * @param map the GameMap to initialize from.
	 */
	public GameState(@NotNull GameMap map) {
		this.boardWidth = map.getWidth();
		this.boardHeight = map.getHeight();
		this.entities = new HashMap<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < boardHeight; y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < boardWidth; x++) {
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				Entity entity = map.getEntityAt(pos);
				this.entities.put(pos, entity);
			}
		}
		this.destinations = new HashSet<>(map.getDestinations());
		this.undoQuota = map.getInitialUndoQuota();
		this.history.clear();
		this.currentTransition = new Transition();
	}
	
	// ... rest of your class code ...
}
```

```java
 * A base implementation of Sokoban Game.

	@NotNull
	protected final GameState state;

	private boolean isExitSpecified = false;

	protected AbstractSokobanGame(@NotNull GameState gameState) {
		this.state = gameState;
	}

	/**
	 * @return True is the game should stop running.
	 * For example when the user specified to exit the game or the user won the game.
	 */
	protected boolean shouldStop() {

	/**
	 * @param action The action received from the user.
	 * @return The result of the action.
	 */
	protected ActionResult processAction(Action action) {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	/**
	 * @param playerPosition The position of the player.
	 * @param move           One-step move. We assume every move has only one step.
	 * @return The action result for the move.
	 */
	@NotNull
	private ActionResult processOneStepMove(@NotNull Position playerPosition, @NotNull Move move) {
		final Position nextPlayerPos = move.nextPosition(playerPosition);
		final Entity nextEntity = this.state.getEntity(nextPlayerPos);

		if (nextEntity instanceof Empty) {
			this.state.move(playerPosition, nextPlayerPos); // move if next place is empty
			return new ActionResult.Success(move);
		}

		if (nextEntity instanceof Wall) {
			return new ActionResult.Failed(move, "You hit a wall.");
		}

		if (nextEntity instanceof Player) {
			return new ActionResult.Failed(move, "You hit another player.");
		}

		if (nextEntity instanceof Box box) {
			if (box.getPlayerId() != move.getInitiator()) {
				return new ActionResult.Failed(move, "You cannot move other players' boxes.");
			}
			final Position nextBoxPos = move.nextPosition(nextPlayerPos);
			if (!(this.state.getEntity(nextBoxPos) instanceof Empty))
				return new ActionResult.Failed(move, "Failed to push the box.");
			this.state.move(nextPlayerPos, nextBoxPos);
			this.state.move(playerPosition, nextPlayerPos);
			// Game history checkpoint reached if any box is moved.
			this.state.checkpoint();
			return new ActionResult.Success(move);
		}
		throw new ShouldNotReachException();
	}
}
```

Response Text:---
The `processAction` method is responsible for handling different user actions in the Sokoban game, such as moves, undo, exit, and invalid inputs. It should analyze the type of action received and perform the corresponding logic, returning an appropriate `ActionResult`.

Here's a brief explanation of how to implement it:
- For `Move` actions, delegate to `processOneStepMove`.
- For `Undo`, check if undo is possible and perform it.
- For `Exit`, set a flag to stop the game.
- For `InvalidInput`, return a failed result with an error message.
- For any other unrecognized actions, return an invalid input result.

Below is a complete implementation of the `processAction` method:

```java
protected ActionResult processAction(Action action) {
    if (action instanceof Move move) {
        Position playerPos = this.state.getPlayerPosition(move.getInitiator());
        if (playerPos == null) {
            return new ActionResult.Failed(move, PLAYER_NOT_FOUND);
        }
        return processOneStepMove(playerPos, move);
    } else if (action instanceof Undo) {
        if (this.state.canUndo()) {
            this.state.undo();
            return new ActionResult.Success(action);
        } else {
            return new ActionResult.Failed(action, UNDO_QUOTA_RUN_OUT);
        }
    } else if (action instanceof Exit) {
        this.isExitSpecified = true;
        return new ActionResult.Success(action);
    } else if (action instanceof InvalidInput) {
        return new ActionResult.Failed(action, "Invalid input.");
    } else {
        // For any other unhandled action types
        return new ActionResult.Failed(action, "Unknown action.");
    }
}
```

The `parse` method needs to process the input string, extract the undo limit, validate it, then parse the map lines to identify entities, track players, boxes, destinations, and ensure all constraints are met. Here's a complete implementation:

```java
public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
    if (mapText == null || mapText.trim().isEmpty()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
    }

    String[] lines = mapText.lines().toArray(String[]::new);
    if (lines.length < 2) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text must contain at least two lines (undo limit + map)");
    }

    // Parse undo limit from the first line
    int undoLimit;
    try {
        undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit");
    }
    if (undoLimit < -1) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
    }

    List<String> mapLines = Arrays.asList(lines).subList(1, lines.length);
    int height = mapLines.size();
    int width = mapLines.stream().mapToInt(String::length).max().orElse(0);

    Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
    Map<Position, Entity> entities = new HashMap<>();
    Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
    Map<Character, Box> boxes = new HashMap<>();
    Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
    Set<Character> boxIds = new HashSet<>();

    // Process each line and character
    for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
        String line = mapLines.get(y);
        for (int x = 0; x < line.length(); x++) {
            char ch = line.charAt(x);
            Position pos = new Position(x, y);
            switch (ch) {
                case '#':
                    entities.put(pos, new Wall());
                    break;
                case '@':
                    destinations.add(pos);
                    entities.put(pos, new Empty()); // or keep as Empty, destinations are tracked separately
                    break;
                case '.':
                    entities.put(pos, new Empty());
                    break;
                default:
                    if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
                        // Player
                        if (playerIds.contains(ch)) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
                        }
                        playerIds.add(ch);
                        if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player ID: " + ch);
                        }
                        playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
                        entities.put(pos, new Player(ch));
                    } else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
                        // Box
                        char upperId = Character.toUpperCase(ch);
                        Box box = new Box(upperId);
                        boxes.put(ch, box);
                        entities.put(pos, box);
                        boxIds.add(ch);
                    } else {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid map character: " + ch);
                    }
            }
        }
    }

    // Validate players
    if (playerIds.isEmpty()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
    }

    // Validate boxes and their corresponding players
    Set<Character> boxPlayerIds = boxes.keySet().stream()
            .map(Character::toUpperCase)
            .collect(Collectors.toSet());

    if (!playerIds.equals(boxPlayerIds)) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Mismatch between players and boxes");
    }

    // Check boxes' getPlayerId() matches existing players
    for (Map.Entry<Character, Box> entry : boxes.entrySet()) {
        char boxChar = entry.getKey();
        Box box = entry.getValue();
        int playerId = box.getPlayerId();
        if (!playerIds.contains(playerId)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Box with ID " + boxChar + " has invalid player ID " + (char) playerId);
        }
    }

    // Check boxes count matches destinations
    long boxCount = boxes.size();
    long destinationCount = destinations.size();
    if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes does not match number of destinations");
    }

    // Create and return GameMap
    return new GameMap(width, height, destinations, undoLimit);
}
```

**Explanation:**
- Parses the first line as undo limit, validating it.
- Processes each subsequent line to identify entities based on characters.
- Tracks players, ensuring no duplicates, and records their positions.
- Tracks boxes, associating each with its player ID.
- Validates that all players and boxes are correctly matched.
- Ensures the number of boxes equals the number of destinations.
- Constructs and returns a `GameMap` instance with the parsed data.

This implementation ensures all constraints and validation rules are enforced, enabling the game map to be correctly parsed and instantiated.

/**
     * Parses the map from a string representation.
     * The first line is undo limit.
     * Starting from the second line, the game map is represented as follows,
     * <li># represents a {@link Wall}</li>
     * <li>@ represents a box destination.</li>
     * <li>Any upper-case letter represents a {@link Player}.</li>
     * <li>
     * Any lower-case letter represents a {@link Box} that is only movable by the player with the corresponding upper-case letter.
     * For instance, box "a" can only be moved by player "A" and not movable by player "B".

public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
    if (mapText == null || mapText.trim().isEmpty()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
    }

    String[] lines = mapText.lines().toArray(String[]::new);
    if (lines.length < 2) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text must contain at least two lines (undo limit + map)");
    }

    // Parse undo limit from the first line
    int undoLimit;
    try {
        undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit");
    }
    if (undoLimit < -1) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
    }

    List<String> mapLines = Arrays.asList(lines).subList(1, lines.length);
    int height = mapLines.size();
    int width = mapLines.stream().mapToInt(String::length).max().orElse(0);

    Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
    Map<Position, Entity> entities = new HashMap<>();
    Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
    Map<Character, Box> boxes = new HashMap<>();
    Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
    Set<Character> boxIds = new HashSet<>();

    // Process each line and character
    for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
        String line = mapLines.get(y);
        for (int x = 0; x < line.length(); x++) {
            char ch = line.charAt(x);
            Position pos = new Position(x, y);
            switch (ch) {
                case '#':
                    entities.put(pos, new Wall());
                    break;
                case '@':
                    destinations.add(pos);
                    entities.put(pos, new Empty()); // or keep as Empty, destinations are tracked separately
                    break;
                case '.':
                    entities.put(pos, new Empty());
                    break;
                default:
                    if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
                        // Player
                        if (playerIds.contains(ch)) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
                        }
                        playerIds.add(ch);
                        if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player ID: " + ch);
                        }
                        playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
                        entities.put(pos, new Player(ch));
                    } else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
                        // Box
                        char upperId = Character.toUpperCase(ch);
                        Box box = new Box(upperId);
                        boxes.put(ch, box);
                        entities.put(pos, box);
                        boxIds.add(ch);
                    } else {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid map character: " + ch);
                    }
            }
        }
    }

    // Validate players
    if (playerIds.isEmpty()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
    }

    // Validate boxes and their corresponding players
    Set<Character> boxPlayerIds = boxes.keySet().stream()
            .map(Character::toUpperCase)
            .collect(Collectors.toSet());

    if (!playerIds.equals(boxPlayerIds)) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Mismatch between players and boxes");
    }

    // Check boxes' getPlayerId() matches existing players
    for (Map.Entry<Character, Box> entry : boxes.entrySet()) {
        char boxChar = entry.getKey();
        Box box = entry.getValue();
        int playerId = box.getPlayerId();
        if (!playerIds.contains(playerId)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Box with ID " + boxChar + " has invalid player ID " + (char) playerId);
        }
    }

    // Check boxes count matches destinations
    long boxCount = boxes.size();
    long destinationCount = destinations.size();
    if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes does not match number of destinations");
    }

    // Create and return GameMap
    return new GameMap(width, height, destinations, undoLimit);
