```java
	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.trim().isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.lines().toArray(String[]::new);
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text must contain at least two lines (undo limit + map)");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
		}
		List<String> mapLines = Arrays.asList(lines).subList(1, lines.length);
		int height = mapLines.size();
		int width = mapLines.stream().mapToInt(String::length).max().orElse(0);
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Position, Entity> entities = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Box> boxes = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
		Set<Character> boxIds = new HashSet<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = mapLines.get(y);
			for (int x = 0; x < line.length(); x++) {
				char ch = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				switch (ch) {
				case '#':
					entities.put(pos, new Wall());
					break;
				case '@':
					destinations.add(pos);
					entities.put(pos, new Empty());
					break;
				case '.':
					entities.put(pos, new Empty());
					break;
				default:
					if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
						if (playerIds.contains(ch)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
						}
						playerIds.add(ch);
						if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player ID: " + ch);
						}
						playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
						entities.put(pos, new Player(ch));
					} else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
						char upperId = Character.toUpperCase(ch);
						Box box = new Box(upperId);
						boxes.put(ch, box);
						entities.put(pos, box);
						boxIds.add(ch);
					} else {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid map character: " + ch);
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (playerIds.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
		}
		Set<Character> boxPlayerIds = boxes.keySet().stream().map(Character::toUpperCase).collect(Collectors.toSet());
		if (!playerIds.equals(boxPlayerIds)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Mismatch between players and boxes");
		}
		for (Map.Entry<Character, Box> entry : boxes.entrySet()) {
			char boxChar = entry.getKey();
			Box box = entry.getValue();
			int playerId = box.getPlayerId();
			if (!playerIds.contains(playerId)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box with ID " + boxChar + " has invalid player ID " + (char) playerId);
			}
		}
		long boxCount = boxes.size();
		long destinationCount = destinations.size();
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes does not match number of destinations");
		}
		return new GameMap(width, height, destinations, undoLimit);
	}

	public Entity getEntity(@NotNull Position position) {
		return map.getOrDefault(position, null);
	}
}
```

The method `getPlayerIds()` should iterate over the `map` field of `GameMap`, identify all `Player` entities, extract their IDs, and collect these IDs into a set. Since the `map` stores `Entity` objects, we need to filter for instances of `Player`, then get their IDs.

Here's a complete implementation:

```java
public Set<Integer> getPlayerIds() {
    return map.values().stream()
            .filter(entity -> entity instanceof Player)
            .map(entity -> ((Player) entity).getId())
            .collect(Collectors.toSet());
}
```

```java
package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import assignment.entities.Wall;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * A Sokoban game board.
 * GameBoard consists of information loaded from map data, such as
 * <li>Width and height of the game map</li>
 * <li>Walls in the map</li>
 * <li>Box destinations</li>
 * <li>Initial locations of boxes and player</li>
 * <p/>
 * GameBoard is capable to create many GameState instances, each representing an ongoing game.
 */
public class GameMap {

	private final Map<Position, Entity> map;

	private final int maxWidth;

	private final int maxHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private final int undoLimit;

	/**
	 * Create a new GameMap with width, height, set of box destinations and undo limit.
	 *
	 * @param maxWidth     Width of the game map.
	 * @param maxHeight    Height of the game map.
	 * @param destinations Set of box destination positions.
	 * @param undoLimit    Undo limit.
	 *                     Positive numbers specify the maximum number of undo actions.
	 *                     0 means undo is not allowed.
	 *                     -1 means unlimited. Other negative numbers are not allowed.
	 */
	public GameMap(int maxWidth, int maxHeight, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.maxWidth = maxWidth;
		this.maxHeight = maxHeight;
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.map = new HashMap<>();
	}

	private GameMap(Map<Position, Entity> map, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.map = Collections.unmodifiableMap(map);
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.maxWidth = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::x).max().orElse(0) + 1;
		this.maxHeight = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::y).max().orElse(0) + 1;
	}

	/**
	 * Get all players' id as a set.
	 *
	 * @return a set of player id.
	 */
	public Set<Integer> getPlayerIds() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum width of the game map.
	 *
	 * @return maximum width.
	 */
	public int getMaxWidth() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.

	public int getMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.trim().isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.lines().toArray(String[]::new);
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text must contain at least two lines (undo limit + map)");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
		}
		List<String> mapLines = Arrays.asList(lines).subList(1, lines.length);
		int height = mapLines.size();
		int width = mapLines.stream().mapToInt(String::length).max().orElse(0);
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Position, Entity> entities = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Box> boxes = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
		Set<Character> boxIds = new HashSet<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = mapLines.get(y);
			for (int x = 0; x < line.length(); x++) {
				char ch = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				switch (ch) {
				case '#':
					entities.put(pos, new Wall());
					break;
				case '@':
					destinations.add(pos);
					entities.put(pos, new Empty());
					break;
				case '.':
					entities.put(pos, new Empty());
					break;
				default:
					if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
						if (playerIds.contains(ch)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
						}
						playerIds.add(ch);
						if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player ID: " + ch);
						}
						playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
						entities.put(pos, new Player(ch));
					} else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
						char upperId = Character.toUpperCase(ch);
						Box box = new Box(upperId);
						boxes.put(ch, box);
						entities.put(pos, box);
						boxIds.add(ch);
					} else {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid map character: " + ch);
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (playerIds.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
		}
		Set<Character> boxPlayerIds = boxes.keySet().stream().map(Character::toUpperCase).collect(Collectors.toSet());
		if (!playerIds.equals(boxPlayerIds)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Mismatch between players and boxes");
		}
		for (Map.Entry<Character, Box> entry : boxes.entrySet()) {
			char boxChar = entry.getKey();
			Box box = entry.getValue();
			int playerId = box.getPlayerId();
			if (!playerIds.contains(playerId)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box with ID " + boxChar + " has invalid player ID " + (char) playerId);
			}
		}
		long boxCount = boxes.size();
		long destinationCount = destinations.size();
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes does not match number of destinations");
		}
		return new GameMap(width, height, destinations, undoLimit);
	}

	public Entity getEntity(@NotNull Position position) {
		return map.getOrDefault(position, null);
	}

	public void putEntity(Position position, Entity entity) {
		map.put(position, entity);
	}

	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoLimit() {
		return Optional.of(undoLimit);
	}
}
```

```java
	}
```

	}

```java
		return Optional.of(undoLimit);
	}

	public Set<Integer> getPlayerIds() {
		return map.values().stream().filter(entity -> entity instanceof Player).map(entity -> ((Player) entity).getId())

	}
```

```java
package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import assignment.entities.Wall;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * A Sokoban game board.
 * GameBoard consists of information loaded from map data, such as
 * <li>Width and height of the game map</li>
 * <li>Walls in the map</li>
 * <li>Box destinations</li>
 * <li>Initial locations of boxes and player</li>
 * <p/>
 * GameBoard is capable to create many GameState instances, each representing an ongoing game.
 */
public class GameMap {

	private final Map<Position, Entity> map;

	private final int maxWidth;

	private final int maxHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private final int undoLimit;

	/**
	 * Create a new GameMap with width, height, set of box destinations and undo limit.
	 *
	 * @param maxWidth     Width of the game map.
	 * @param maxHeight    Height of the game map.
	 * @param destinations Set of box destination positions.
	 * @param undoLimit    Undo limit.
	 *                     Positive numbers specify the maximum number of undo actions.
	 *                     0 means undo is not allowed.
	 *                     -1 means unlimited. Other negative numbers are not allowed.
	 */
	public GameMap(int maxWidth, int maxHeight, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.maxWidth = maxWidth;
		this.maxHeight = maxHeight;
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.map = new HashMap<>();
	}

	private GameMap(Map<Position, Entity> map, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.map = Collections.unmodifiableMap(map);
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.maxWidth = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::x).max().orElse(0) + 1;
		this.maxHeight = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::y).max().orElse(0) + 1;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.trim().isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.lines().toArray(String[]::new);
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text must contain at least two lines (undo limit + map)");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
		}
		List<String> mapLines = Arrays.asList(lines).subList(1, lines.length);
		int height = mapLines.size();
		int width = mapLines.stream().mapToInt(String::length).max().orElse(0);
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Position, Entity> entities = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Box> boxes = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
		Set<Character> boxIds = new HashSet<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = mapLines.get(y);
			for (int x = 0; x < line.length(); x++) {
				char ch = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				switch (ch) {
				case '#':
					entities.put(pos, new Wall());
					break;
				case '@':
					destinations.add(pos);
					entities.put(pos, new Empty());
					break;
				case '.':
					entities.put(pos, new Empty());
					break;
				default:
					if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
						if (playerIds.contains(ch)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
						}
						playerIds.add(ch);
						if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player ID: " + ch);
						}
						playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
						entities.put(pos, new Player(ch));
					} else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
						char upperId = Character.toUpperCase(ch);
						Box box = new Box(upperId);
						boxes.put(ch, box);
						entities.put(pos, box);
						boxIds.add(ch);
					} else {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid map character: " + ch);
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (playerIds.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
		}
		Set<Character> boxPlayerIds = boxes.keySet().stream().map(Character::toUpperCase).collect(Collectors.toSet());
		if (!playerIds.equals(boxPlayerIds)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Mismatch between players and boxes");
		}
		for (Map.Entry<Character, Box> entry : boxes.entrySet()) {
			char boxChar = entry.getKey();
			Box box = entry.getValue();
			int playerId = box.getPlayerId();
			if (!playerIds.contains(playerId)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box with ID " + boxChar + " has invalid player ID " + (char) playerId);
			}
		}
		long boxCount = boxes.size();
		long destinationCount = destinations.size();
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes does not match number of destinations");
		}
		return new GameMap(width, height, destinations, undoLimit);
	}

	public Entity getEntity(@NotNull Position position) {
		return map.getOrDefault(position, null);
	}

	public void putEntity(Position position, Entity entity) {
		map.put(position, entity);
	}

	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoLimit() {
		return Optional.of(undoLimit);
	}

	public Set<Integer> getPlayerIds() {
		return map.values().stream().filter(entity -> entity instanceof Player).map(entity -> ((Player) entity).getId())
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	public int getMaxWidth() {
		return maxWidth;
	}
}
```

Response Text:---
The errors indicate that during parsing, the code is attempting to validate that each Box's player ID matches the corresponding Player's ID, but the current implementation incorrectly compares the Box's player ID (which is an uppercase character) with the Player's ID (which is a lowercase character). This mismatch causes the IllegalArgumentException.

**Explanation:**  
In the parsing process, each Box is associated with a lowercase character (e.g., 'a'), and the corresponding Player has an uppercase ID (e.g., 'A'). The validation should check that the uppercase version of the Box's ID matches the Player's ID, not compare the Box's ID directly with the Player's ID.

**Corrected approach:**  
- When validating, convert the Box's ID to uppercase and compare it with the Player's ID.  
- Ensure that the Player's ID is stored as an uppercase character.

Below is a complete, corrected version of the `GameMap` class with the `parse` method fixed accordingly:

```java
package assignment.game;

import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import assignment.entities.Wall;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * A Sokoban game board.
 * GameMap consists of information loaded from map data, such as
 * <li>Width and height of the game map</li>
 * <li>Walls in the map</li>
 * <li>Box destinations</li>
 * <li>Initial locations of boxes and player</li>
 * <p/>
 * GameMap is capable to create many GameState instances, each representing an ongoing game.
 */
public class GameMap {

	private final Map<Position, Entity> map;

	private final int maxWidth;

	private final int maxHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private final int undoLimit;

	/**
	 * Create a new GameMap with width, height, set of box destinations and undo limit.
	 *
	 * @param maxWidth     Width of the game map.
	 * @param maxHeight    Height of the game map.
	 * @param destinations Set of box destination positions.
	 * @param undoLimit    Undo limit.
	 *                     Positive numbers specify the maximum number of undo actions.
	 *                     0 means undo is not allowed.
	 *                     -1 means unlimited. Other negative numbers are not allowed.
	 */
	public GameMap(int maxWidth, int maxHeight, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.maxWidth = maxWidth;
		this.maxHeight = maxHeight;
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.map = new HashMap<>();
	}

	private GameMap(Map<Position, Entity> map, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.map = Collections.unmodifiableMap(map);
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.maxWidth = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::x).max().orElse(0) + 1;
		this.maxHeight = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::y).max().orElse(0) + 1;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMaxHeight() {
		return maxHeight;
	}

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.trim().isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.lines().toArray(String[]::new);
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text must contain at least two lines (undo limit + map)");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
		}
		List<String> mapLines = Arrays.asList(lines).subList(1, lines.length);
		int height = mapLines.size();
		int width = mapLines.stream().mapToInt(String::length).max().orElse(0);
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Position, Entity> entities = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Box> boxes = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
		Set<Character> boxIds = new HashSet<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = mapLines.get(y);
			for (int x = 0; x < line.length(); x++) {
				char ch = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				switch (ch) {
					case '#':
						entities.put(pos, new Wall());
						break;
					case '@':
						destinations.add(pos);
						entities.put(pos, new Empty());
						break;
					case '.':
						entities.put(pos, new Empty());
						break;
					default:
						if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
							if (playerIds.contains(ch)) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
							}
							playerIds.add(ch);
							if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player ID: " + ch);
							}
							playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
							entities.put(pos, new Player(ch));
						} else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
							char upperId = Character.toUpperCase(ch);
							if (boxes.containsKey(ch)) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate box ID: " + ch);
							}
							Box box = new Box(upperId);
							boxes.put(ch, box);
							entities.put(pos, box);
							boxIds.add(ch);
						} else {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid map character: " + ch);
						}
				}
			}
		}
		if (playerIds.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
		}
		// Validate that each box's player ID matches a player
		for (Map.Entry<Character, Box> entry : boxes.entrySet()) {
			char boxChar = entry.getKey();
			Box box = entry.getValue();
			char boxIdUpper = Character.toUpperCase(boxChar);
			// Check if a player with uppercase ID exists
			if (!playerIds.contains(boxIdUpper)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box with ID " + boxChar + " has invalid player ID " + boxIdUpper);
			}
			// Optionally, assign the player ID to the box if needed
			// (assuming Box has a method to set player ID, if necessary)
		}
		long boxCount = boxes.size();
		long destinationCount = destinations.size();
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes does not match number of destinations");
		}
		return new GameMap(width, height, destinations, undoLimit);
	}

	public Entity getEntity(@NotNull Position position) {
		return map.getOrDefault(position, null);
	}

	public void putEntity(Position position, Entity entity) {
		map.put(position, entity);
	}

	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoLimit() {
		return Optional.of(undoLimit);
	}

	public Set<Integer> getPlayerIds() {
		return map.values().stream().filter(entity -> entity instanceof Player).map(entity -> ((Player) entity).getId())
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	public int getMaxWidth() {
		return maxWidth;
	}
```

package assignment.game;

import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * A Sokoban game board.
 * GameMap consists of information loaded from map data, such as
 * <li>Width and height of the game map</li>
 * <li>Walls in the map</li>
 * <li>Box destinations</li>
 * <li>Initial locations of boxes and player</li>
 * <p/>
 * GameMap is capable to create many GameState instances, each representing an ongoing game.
 */
public class GameMap {

	private final Map<Position, Entity> map;

	private final int maxWidth;

	private final int maxHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private final int undoLimit;

	/**
	 * Create a new GameMap with width, height, set of box destinations and undo limit.
	 *
	 * @param maxWidth     Width of the game map.
	 * @param maxHeight    Height of the game map.
	 * @param destinations Set of box destination positions.
	 * @param undoLimit    Undo limit.
	 *                     Positive numbers specify the maximum number of undo actions.
	 *                     0 means undo is not allowed.
	 *                     -1 means unlimited. Other negative numbers are not allowed.
	 */
	public GameMap(int maxWidth, int maxHeight, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.maxWidth = maxWidth;
		this.maxHeight = maxHeight;
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.map = new HashMap<>();
	}

	private GameMap(Map<Position, Entity> map, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.map = Collections.unmodifiableMap(map);
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.maxWidth = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::x).max().orElse(0) + 1;
		this.maxHeight = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::y).max().orElse(0) + 1;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMaxHeight() {
		return maxHeight;
	}

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.trim().isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.lines().toArray(String[]::new);
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text must contain at least two lines (undo limit + map)");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
		}
		List<String> mapLines = Arrays.asList(lines).subList(1, lines.length);
		int height = mapLines.size();
		int width = mapLines.stream().mapToInt(String::length).max().orElse(0);
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Position, Entity> entities = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Box> boxes = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
		Set<Character> boxIds = new HashSet<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = mapLines.get(y);
			for (int x = 0; x < line.length(); x++) {
				char ch = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				switch (ch) {
					case '#':
						entities.put(pos, new Wall());
						break;
					case '@':
						destinations.add(pos);
						entities.put(pos, new Empty());
						break;
					case '.':
						entities.put(pos, new Empty());
						break;
					default:
						if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
							if (playerIds.contains(ch)) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
							}
							playerIds.add(ch);
							if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player ID: " + ch);
							}
							playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
							entities.put(pos, new Player(ch));
						} else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
							char upperId = Character.toUpperCase(ch);
							if (boxes.containsKey(ch)) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate box ID: " + ch);
							}
							Box box = new Box(upperId);
							boxes.put(ch, box);
							entities.put(pos, box);
							boxIds.add(ch);
						} else {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid map character: " + ch);
						}
				}
			}
		}
		if (playerIds.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
		}
		// Validate that each box's player ID matches a player
		for (Map.Entry<Character, Box> entry : boxes.entrySet()) {
			char boxChar = entry.getKey();
			Box box = entry.getValue();
			char boxIdUpper = Character.toUpperCase(boxChar);
			// Check if a player with uppercase ID exists
			if (!playerIds.contains(boxIdUpper)) {

						"Box with ID " + boxChar + " has invalid player ID " + boxIdUpper);
			}
			// Optionally, assign the player ID to the box if needed
			// (assuming Box has a method to set player ID, if necessary)

		long boxCount = boxes.size();
		long destinationCount = destinations.size();
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes does not match number of destinations");
		}

```java
/**
 * A Sokoban game board.
 * GameBoard consists of information loaded from map data, such as
 * <li>Width and height of the game map</li>
 * <li>Walls in the map</li>
 * <li>Box destinations</li>
 * <li>Initial locations of boxes and player</li>
 * <p/>
 * GameBoard is capable to create many GameState instances, each representing an ongoing game.
 */
public class GameMap {

	private final Map<Position, Entity> map;

	private final int maxWidth;

	private final int maxHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private final int undoLimit;

	/**
	 * Create a new GameMap with width, height, set of box destinations and undo limit.
	 *
	 * @param maxWidth     Width of the game map.
	 * @param maxHeight    Height of the game map.
	 * @param destinations Set of box destination positions.
	 * @param undoLimit    Undo limit.
	 *                     Positive numbers specify the maximum number of undo actions.
	 *                     0 means undo is not allowed.
	 *                     -1 means unlimited. Other negative numbers are not allowed.
	 */
	public GameMap(int maxWidth, int maxHeight, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.maxWidth = maxWidth;
		this.maxHeight = maxHeight;
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.map = new HashMap<>();
	}

	private GameMap(Map<Position, Entity> map, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.map = Collections.unmodifiableMap(map);
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.maxWidth = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::x).max().orElse(0) + 1;
		this.maxHeight = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::y).max().orElse(0) + 1;
	}

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.trim().isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.lines().toArray(String[]::new);
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text must contain at least two lines (undo limit + map)");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
		}
		List<String> mapLines = Arrays.asList(lines).subList(1, lines.length);
		int height = mapLines.size();
		int width = mapLines.stream().mapToInt(String::length).max().orElse(0);
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Position, Entity> entities = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Box> boxes = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
		Set<Character> boxIds = new HashSet<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = mapLines.get(y);
			for (int x = 0; x < line.length(); x++) {
				char ch = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				switch (ch) {
				case '#':
					entities.put(pos, new Wall());
					break;
				case '@':
					destinations.add(pos);
					entities.put(pos, new Empty());
					break;
				case '.':
					entities.put(pos, new Empty());
					break;
				default:
					if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
						if (playerIds.contains(ch)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
						}
						playerIds.add(ch);
						if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player ID: " + ch);
						}
						playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
						entities.put(pos, new Player(ch));
					} else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
						char upperId = Character.toUpperCase(ch);
						Box box = new Box(upperId);
						boxes.put(ch, box);
						entities.put(pos, box);
						boxIds.add(ch);
					} else {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid map character: " + ch);
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (playerIds.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
		}
		Set<Character> boxPlayerIds = boxes.keySet().stream().map(Character::toUpperCase).collect(Collectors.toSet());
		if (!playerIds.equals(boxPlayerIds)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Mismatch between players and boxes");
		}
		for (Map.Entry<Character, Box> entry : boxes.entrySet()) {
			char boxChar = entry.getKey();
			Box box = entry.getValue();
			int playerId = box.getPlayerId();
			if (!playerIds.contains(playerId)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box with ID " + boxChar + " has invalid player ID " + (char) playerId);
			}
		}
		long boxCount = boxes.size();
		long destinationCount = destinations.size();
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes does not match number of destinations");
		}
		return new GameMap(width, height, destinations, undoLimit);
	}

	public Entity getEntity(@NotNull Position position) {
		return map.getOrDefault(position, null);
	}

	public void putEntity(Position position, Entity entity) {
		map.put(position, entity);
	}

	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoLimit() {
		return Optional.of(undoLimit);
	}

	public Set<Integer> getPlayerIds() {
		return map.values().stream().filter(entity -> entity instanceof Player).map(entity -> ((Player) entity).getId())
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	public int getMaxWidth() {
		return maxWidth;
	}
}
```

package assignment.game;

import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import assignment.entities.Wall;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * A Sokoban game board.
 * GameMap consists of information loaded from map data, such as
 * <li>Width and height of the game map</li>
 * <li>Walls in the map</li>
 * <li>Box destinations</li>
 * <li>Initial locations of boxes and player</li>
 * <p/>
 * GameMap is capable to create many GameState instances, each representing an ongoing game.
 */
public class GameMap {

	private final Map<Position, Entity> map;

	private final int maxWidth;

	private final int maxHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private final int undoLimit;

	/**
	 * Create a new GameMap with width, height, set of box destinations and undo limit.
	 *
	 * @param maxWidth     Width of the game map.
	 * @param maxHeight    Height of the game map.
	 * @param destinations Set of box destination positions.
	 * @param undoLimit    Undo limit.
	 *                     Positive numbers specify the maximum number of undo actions.
	 *                     0 means undo is not allowed.
	 *                     -1 means unlimited. Other negative numbers are not allowed.
	 */
	public GameMap(int maxWidth, int maxHeight, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.maxWidth = maxWidth;
		this.maxHeight = maxHeight;
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.map = new HashMap<>();
	}

	private GameMap(Map<Position, Entity> map, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.map = Collections.unmodifiableMap(map);
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.maxWidth = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::x).max().orElse(0) + 1;
		this.maxHeight = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::y).max().orElse(0) + 1;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMaxHeight() {
		return maxHeight;
	}

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.trim().isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.lines().toArray(String[]::new);
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text must contain at least two lines (undo limit + map)");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
		}
		List<String> mapLines = Arrays.asList(lines).subList(1, lines.length);
		int height = mapLines.size();
		int width = mapLines.stream().mapToInt(String::length).max().orElse(0);
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Position, Entity> entities = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Box> boxes = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
		Set<Character> boxIds = new HashSet<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = mapLines.get(y);
			for (int x = 0; x < line.length(); x++) {
				char ch = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				switch (ch) {
					case '#':
						entities.put(pos, new Wall());
						break;
					case '@':
						destinations.add(pos);
						entities.put(pos, new Empty());
						break;
					case '.':
						entities.put(pos, new Empty());
						break;
					default:
						if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
							if (playerIds.contains(ch)) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
							}
							playerIds.add(ch);
							if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player ID: " + ch);
							}
							playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
							entities.put(pos, new Player(ch));
						} else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
							char upperId = Character.toUpperCase(ch);
							if (boxes.containsKey(ch)) {
								throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate box ID: " + ch);
							}
							Box box = new Box(upperId);
							boxes.put(ch, box);
							entities.put(pos, box);
							boxIds.add(ch);
						} else {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid map character: " + ch);
						}
				}
			}
		}
		if (playerIds.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
		}
		// Validate that each box's player ID matches a player
		for (Map.Entry<Character, Box> entry : boxes.entrySet()) {
			char boxChar = entry.getKey();
			Box box = entry.getValue();
			char boxIdUpper = Character.toUpperCase(boxChar);
			// Check if a player with uppercase ID exists
			if (!playerIds.contains(boxIdUpper)) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box with ID " + boxChar + " has invalid player ID " + boxIdUpper);
			}
			// Optionally, assign the player ID to the box if needed
			// (assuming Box has a method to set player ID, if necessary)
		}
		long boxCount = boxes.size();
		long destinationCount = destinations.size();
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes does not match number of destinations");
		}
		return new GameMap(width, height, destinations, undoLimit);
	}

	public Entity getEntity(@NotNull Position position) {
		return map.getOrDefault(position, null);
	}

	public void putEntity(Position position, Entity entity) {
		map.put(position, entity);
	}

	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoLimit() {
		return Optional.of(undoLimit);
	}

	public Set<Integer> getPlayerIds() {
		return map.values().stream().filter(entity -> entity instanceof Player).map(entity -> ((Player) entity).getId())
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	public int getMaxWidth() {
		return maxWidth;
	}
}

Response Text:---
The errors indicate that the code is validating that each Box's ID (a lowercase character) must correspond to an existing Player's ID (an uppercase character). The current implementation incorrectly checks if the uppercase version of the box's ID exists among the set of player IDs, but it does not verify whether a Player with that uppercase ID actually exists in the map. 

To fix this, the code should verify that for each box, there is a Player entity with the same uppercase ID in the map. This requires checking the map's entities for a Player with the matching ID, not just the set of player IDs collected during parsing.

Here's the corrected version of the `parse` method, focusing on the validation logic:

```java
public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
    if (mapText == null || mapText.trim().isEmpty()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
    }
    String[] lines = mapText.lines().toArray(String[]::new);
    if (lines.length < 2) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text must contain at least two lines (undo limit + map)");
    }
    int undoLimit;
    try {
        undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit");
    }
    if (undoLimit < -1) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
    }
    List<String> mapLines = Arrays.asList(lines).subList(1, lines.length);
    int height = mapLines.size();
    int width = mapLines.stream().mapToInt(String::length).max().orElse(0);
    Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
    Map<Position, Entity> entities = new HashMap<>();
    Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
    Map<Character, Box> boxes = new HashMap<>();
    Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
    Set<Character> boxIds = new HashSet<>();
    for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
        String line = mapLines.get(y);
        for (int x = 0; x < line.length(); x++) {
            char ch = line.charAt(x);
            Position pos = new Position(x, y);
            switch (ch) {
                case '#':
                    entities.put(pos, new Wall());
                    break;
                case '@':
                    destinations.add(pos);
                    entities.put(pos, new Empty());
                    break;
                case '.':
                    entities.put(pos, new Empty());
                    break;
                default:
                    if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
                        if (playerIds.contains(ch)) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
                        }
                        playerIds.add(ch);
                        if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player ID: " + ch);
                        }
                        playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
                        entities.put(pos, new Player(ch));
                    } else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
                        if (boxIds.contains(ch)) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate box ID: " + ch);
                        }
                        Box box = new Box(Character.toUpperCase(ch));
                        boxes.put(ch, box);
                        entities.put(pos, box);
                        boxIds.add(ch);
                    } else {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid map character: " + ch);
                    }
            }
        }
    }
    if (playerIds.isEmpty()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
    }
    // Validate that each box's player ID corresponds to an existing Player entity
    for (Map.Entry<Character, Box> entry : boxes.entrySet()) {
        char boxChar = entry.getKey();
        char boxIdUpper = Character.toUpperCase(boxChar);
        boolean playerExists = entities.values().stream()
            .anyMatch(entity -> entity instanceof Player && ((Player) entity).getId() == boxIdUpper);
        if (!playerExists) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Box with ID " + boxChar + " has invalid player ID " + boxIdUpper);
        }
    }
    long boxCount = boxes.size();
    long destinationCount = destinations.size();
    if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes does not match number of destinations");
    }
    return new GameMap(width, height, destinations, undoLimit);
}
```

**Summary:**  
- The validation now explicitly checks if a Player with the uppercase ID exists in the map's entities.  
- This ensures that each box's ID correctly matches an existing Player, preventing the `IllegalArgumentException` errors during tests.

        char boxChar = entry.getKey();
        char boxIdUpper = Character.toUpperCase(boxChar);
        boolean playerExists = entities.values().stream()
            .anyMatch(entity -> entity instanceof Player && ((Player) entity).getId() == boxIdUpper);
        if (!playerExists) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Box with ID " + boxChar + " has invalid player ID " + boxIdUpper);
        }
    }
    long boxCount = boxes.size();
    long destinationCount = destinations.size();
    if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes does not match number of destinations");
    }
    return new GameMap(width, height, destinations, undoLimit);

public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
    if (mapText == null || mapText.trim().isEmpty()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
    }
    String[] lines = mapText.lines().toArray(String[]::new);
    if (lines.length < 2) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text must contain at least two lines (undo limit + map)");
    }
    int undoLimit;
    try {
        undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit");
    }
    if (undoLimit < -1) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
    }
    List<String> mapLines = Arrays.asList(lines).subList(1, lines.length);
    int height = mapLines.size();
    int width = mapLines.stream().mapToInt(String::length).max().orElse(0);
    Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
    Map<Position, Entity> entities = new HashMap<>();
    Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
    Map<Character, Box> boxes = new HashMap<>();
    Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
    Set<Character> boxIds = new HashSet<>();
    for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
        String line = mapLines.get(y);
        for (int x = 0; x < line.length(); x++) {
            char ch = line.charAt(x);
            Position pos = new Position(x, y);
            switch (ch) {
                case '#':
                    entities.put(pos, new Wall());
                    break;
                case '@':
                    destinations.add(pos);
                    entities.put(pos, new Empty());
                    break;
                case '.':
                    entities.put(pos, new Empty());
                    break;
                default:
                    if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
                        if (playerIds.contains(ch)) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
                        }
                        playerIds.add(ch);
                        if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate player ID: " + ch);
                        }
                        playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
                        entities.put(pos, new Player(ch));
                    } else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
                        if (boxIds.contains(ch)) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate box ID: " + ch);
                        }
                        Box box = new Box(Character.toUpperCase(ch));
                        boxes.put(ch, box);
                        entities.put(pos, box);
                        boxIds.add(ch);
                    } else {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid map character: " + ch);
                    }
            }
        }
    }
    if (playerIds.isEmpty()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
    }
    // Validate that each box's player ID corresponds to an existing Player entity
    for (Map.Entry<Character, Box> entry : boxes.entrySet()) {
        char boxChar = entry.getKey();
        char boxIdUpper = Character.toUpperCase(boxChar);

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Box with ID " + boxChar + " has invalid player ID " + boxIdUpper);
        }
    }

    long destinationCount = destinations.size();

    }

```java
@Override
public Action fetchAction() {
    final String inputLine = terminalScanner.nextLine().trim();

    if (inputLine.isEmpty()) {
        return new InvalidInput();
    }

    // Check for exit command
    if (inputLine.equalsIgnoreCase(EXIT_COMMAND_TEXT)) {
        return new Exit();
    }

    // Check for undo command
    if (inputLine.equalsIgnoreCase("U")) {
        return new Undo();
    }

    // Check for move commands using regex
    Matcher matcher = MOVE_REGEX.matcher(inputLine);
    if (matcher.matches()) {
        char commandChar = inputLine.charAt(0);
        switch (Character.toUpperCase(commandChar)) {
            case 'W':
                return new Move(Direction.UP);
            case 'A':
                return new Move(Direction.LEFT);
            case 'S':
                return new Move(Direction.DOWN);
            case 'D':
                return new Move(Direction.RIGHT);
            case 'H':
                return new Move(Direction.HELP); // Assuming 'H' for help or other action
            case 'J':
                return new Move(Direction.JUMP); // Example, depends on game logic
            case 'K':
                return new Move(Direction.K); // Placeholder
            case 'L':
                return new Move(Direction.L);
            default:
                return new InvalidInput();
        }
    }

    // If input doesn't match any command, return invalid input
    return new InvalidInput();
}
```

```java
package assignment.tui;
```

```java
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import assignment.entities.Wall;
import assignment.game.GameState;
import assignment.game.Position;
import assignment.game.RenderingEngine;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

import java.io.PrintStream;

/**
 * A rendering engine that prints to the terminal.
 */
public class TerminalRenderingEngine implements RenderingEngine {

	private final PrintStream outputStream;

	/**
	 * @param outputStream The {@link PrintStream} to write the output to.
	 */
	public TerminalRenderingEngine(PrintStream outputStream) {
		this.outputStream = outputStream;
	}

	@Override
	public void render(@NotNull GameState state) {
		final StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
		for (int y = 0; y < state.getMapMaxHeight(); y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < state.getMapMaxWidth(); x++) {
				final Entity entity = state.getEntity(Position.of(x, y));
				char charToPrint = ' ';
				if (entity instanceof Wall) {
					charToPrint = '#';
				}
				if (entity instanceof Box box) {
					charToPrint = (char) (box.getPlayerId() + 'a');
				}
				if (entity instanceof Player player) {
					charToPrint = (char) (player.getId() + 'A');
				}
				if (entity instanceof Empty) {
					charToPrint = state.getDestinations().contains(new Position(x, y)) ? '@' : '.';
				}
				builder.append(charToPrint);
			}
			builder.append('\n');
		}
		outputStream.print(builder);
	}

	@Override
	public void message(String content) {
		// TODO
		// Hint: System.out is also a PrintStream.
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}
}
```

```java
/**
 * A rendering engine that prints to the terminal.

public class TerminalRenderingEngine implements RenderingEngine {

	private final PrintStream outputStream;

	/**
	 * @param outputStream The {@link PrintStream} to write the output to.
	 */
	public TerminalRenderingEngine(PrintStream outputStream) {
		this.outputStream = outputStream;
	}

	@Override
	public void render(@NotNull GameState state) {
		final StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
		for (int y = 0; y < state.getMapMaxHeight(); y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < state.getMapMaxWidth(); x++) {
```

```java
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

import java.io.PrintStream;

/**
 * A rendering engine that prints to the terminal.
 */
public class TerminalRenderingEngine implements RenderingEngine {

	private final PrintStream outputStream;

	/**
	 * @param outputStream The {@link PrintStream} to write the output to.
	 */
	public TerminalRenderingEngine(PrintStream outputStream) {
		this.outputStream = outputStream;
	}

	@Override
	public void render(@NotNull GameState state) {
		final StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
		for (int y = 0; y < state.getMapMaxHeight(); y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < state.getMapMaxWidth(); x++) {
				final Entity entity = state.getEntity(Position.of(x, y));
				char charToPrint = ' ';
				if (entity instanceof Wall) {
					charToPrint = '#';
				}
				if (entity instanceof Box box) {
					charToPrint = (char) (box.getPlayerId() + 'a');
				}
				if (entity instanceof Player player) {
					charToPrint = (char) (player.getId() + 'A');
				}
				if (entity instanceof Empty) {
					charToPrint = state.getDestinations().contains(new Position(x, y)) ? '@' : '.';
				}
				builder.append(charToPrint);
			}
			builder.append('\n');
		}
		outputStream.print(builder);
	}

	@Override
	public void message(String content) {
```
		outputStream.println(content);
	}

```java
public void run() {
```
```java
    boolean gameRunning = true;
    while (gameRunning) {
        // Render the current game state
        renderingEngine.render(this.getGameState());

        // Get user input
        String input = inputEngine.getInput();

            renderingEngine.renderGameOver(this.getGameState());

}
```
